discovery.title: A 1,500-year-old clay figure may show a woman guarding a tomb
discovery.summary: Archaeologists found a carefully detailed haniwa figure at a fifth-century burial mound in Gunma, Japan. Experts think it may depict a miko, a female ritual figure.
discovery.why_it_matters: The figure offers a vivid glimpse of funeral practices and the ceremonial roles women may have held in ancient Japan.
